title: Phrases that calm Mom
intro: Short, warm phrases for the moments that come up most. Keep your voice low and slow, and use Mom's name.

phrases.text: We have plenty of time. I'll let you know when it's time.
phrases.when: When the same question about plans or time comes up again

phrases.text: Good question. Let's look at the calendar together.
phrases.when: When a written answer can help more than a spoken one

phrases.text: You're safe. I'm here with you.
phrases.when: Late afternoon or evening, when confusion or worry grows

phrases.text: It's been a long day. Let's sit down together for a bit.
phrases.when: When restlessness starts as the day ends

phrases.text: I'm right here. Let's have some tea while we wait.
phrases.when: When the question comes from worry, not from missing facts

footer: We teach and organize. We don't give medical advice.
